# Vision Transformer (ViT)

**Category:** ViT · **Code:**
[`timm/models/vision_transformer.py`](https://github.com/huggingface/pytorch-image-models/blob/main/timm/models/vision_transformer.py)
· **Architectures:** 157 · **Pretrained weights:** 302 (96 with ImageNet-1k results)

The Vision Transformer (ViT) splits an image into fixed size patches, linearly embeds them and processes the resulting
token sequence with a standard Transformer encoder. This module holds the `VisionTransformer` class and the weights for
the original ViT, the "How to train your ViT?" (AugReg) and FlexiViT models, and many image-text (CLIP, SigLIP) and
self-supervised pretrained image towers that share the architecture.

## Papers

* [An Image Is Worth 16 x 16 Words: Transformers for Image Recognition at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2010.11929)
* [How to train your ViT? Data, Augmentation, and Regularization in Vision
  Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2106.10270)
* [FlexiViT: One Model for All Patch Sizes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.08013)

## Usage

See the [Quickstart](../quickstart) for loading pretrained weights, image preprocessing and fine-tuning, and [Feature
Extraction](../feature_extraction) for using the models as backbones.

```py
>>> import timm
>>> model = timm.create_model('vit_base_patch16_224.augreg2_in21k_ft_in1k', pretrained=True)
>>> data_config = timm.data.resolve_model_data_config(model)
```

| [Layer-wise LR decay (`group_matcher()`)](../model_api#training-hooks) | ✓ |
| [`reset_classifier()`](../model_api#classifier) | ✓ |

✓ supported, ✓ (square) works for square sizes only, ✗ not supported, – not needed (the model already accepts any input
size). Checked by running each feature on a randomly initialized model (`VisionTransformer` with `vit_tiny_patch16_224`
at 224), other architectures of the same class are expected to behave the same. See the [Model API](../model_api) page
for details.
